Give us great glory! Gloss: n̥sméy = to us (dat. 1pl); méǵh₂ = great; ḱléwos = glory/fame; dʰedʰh₁dʰí = give! (reduplicated imperative).

A king wished for a son. He asked his priest: "May a son be born to me!" The priest said to that king: "Sacrifice to the god Varuna." A sheep that had no wool saw horses: one pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, and one carrying a man quickly. Gloss: owis = sheep; yāi = on which; wl̥nā = wool; ne eest = was not; dedorḱe = saw; eḱwons = horses (acc. pl.); tom = that/one; woǵʰom = wagon; gʷr̥um = heavy; weǵʰontm̥ = pulling/carrying; bʰorom = load; meǵm̥ = great; ǵʰm̥onm̥ = man; ōku = quickly; bʰerontm̥ = carrying.

Give us imperishable glory! Gloss: ń̥dʰgʷʰitom = imperishable; nos = to us; ḱléwos = glory; dʰedʰh₁dʰí = give!

"I want a son." "So be it," said the bright god Varuna. Then the king's wife bore a son. Gloss: súHnum = son; wēlh₁mi = I want; tód = that; h₁estu = let it be; wéwked = said; lewkós = bright; deywós = god; wérunos = Varuna; nu = then; h₃réḱs = king (gen.); pótnih₂ = wife/lady; ǵeǵonh₁e = bore.

You lie slain. Gloss: gʷʰn̥tṓs = slain/struck; ḱéydʰwe = you (pl.) lie.

"Hear me, father Varuna!" The god Varuna came down from heaven. Gloss: ḱludʰí = hear!; moi = me; pter = father; werune = Varuna (voc.); deywós = god; wérunos = Varuna; diwés = from heaven; km̥tá = down; gʷah₂t = came.
The sheep, having heard that, fled to the field.

Let the bone grow from the bone.

Kʷékʷlos moi h₁ésti. Tód tei dídh₃mi.
English: I have a wheel. I give it to you.

Dʰwóri h₂nḗr stéh₂ti? Tóm né leikʷō. H₃éwim pékʷō.
English: A man is standing at the door? I will not leave him. I cook a sheep.

Ph₂tḗr dómi h₁ésti.
English: Father is in the house.

Éy, dóru édʰeh₁m.
English: Yes, I made the spear.

H₂nḗr dʰwóri stéh₂ti.
English: A man is standing at the door.

Éy, h₃éwim éwidom.
English: Yes, I saw the sheep.

Éy, h₁égʷnis dʰégʷʰeti, bʰráh₂ter.
English: Yes, the fire is burning, brother.

Éy, h₁éḱwom wesnéh₂si.
English: Yes, you are buying the horse.

Tód h₃éwyos h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ h₁ésti.
English: This is the sheep's wool.

Dómi tewe h₁édō, tī pībō.
English: I will eat in your house, and drink there.

Pékū ǵʰórdʰi h₁ésti.
English: The flock is in the enclosure.

Sā pontéh₂s h₃rēǵós dómm̥ h₁éyti.
English: This road goes to the king's house.

Dʰérǵʰō h₂érh₃trom; gʷṓw dwóh₁ h₂érh₃trei yeugō.
English: I hold the plough; I join the two cattle to the plough.

Séh₂wōl nókʷtim h₁éyti.
English: The sun goes to the night.
"Let it be that," said the shining god Varuna.
